checks.rationale: Read-only flat assets module builds immutable source catalogs using accepted values and offline validation. Initialization, state mutation, upgrades, wiring and packaging remain with TASK-031/032/034/037.

ADRs 001-005 are preserved: flat Python/v1 JSON, no canonical-state writer, isolated exact candidate, separate higher-rank R1/R2 and hash manifests distinguishing managed assets from project seeds. Native selection provenance and unavailable provider confirmation are stated explicitly.

Accepted TASK-004 candidate/integration are ancestors of the review base. Its five relevant helper/installer sources remain byte-identical; both accepted reviews pass. TASK-001 ScopePath, frozen JSON, digest and domain-error contracts are consumed unchanged.

Public assets imports are explicit flat modules with typed frozen records. The catalog uses ContractRegistry.validate and shared ScopePath/Sha256Digest/error semantics. Both provider tool payloads retain every local import in the accepted four-module closure.

Current framework version matches the installer. The combined manifest uses existing v1 ownership values; its managed projection exactly equals each existing Codex/Claude manifest. Seed hashes intentionally identify canonical defaults before dynamic project/provider instantiation.

No schema, persistence or migration implementation changed; migration IDs remain empty. All three catalog/install records and 12 JSON seeds validate offline. Unsupported schema versions, unknown nested fields and framework-version drift reject through accepted non-retryable domain errors.

The exact four changed paths fit approved scope, with no prohibited edits. Flat src/assets.py, a separate nonempty test leaf and plan-local handoff follow repository conventions. Provider destinations and source references remain portable and canonical product history is excluded.

The new consumer-facing catalog is TASK-005-owned. Bootstrap source discovery/rendering remains temporarily in unchanged install.py because TASK-031 owns that integration; exact managed-manifest/payload parity checks guard this documented overlap. No competing initializer or upgrader was added.

Catalog ownership matches existing framework/seed_only schema vocabulary and installation roots. Across all three roots, each payload has exactly one matching ownership root and none in the opposite class. framework.json and generated manifest metadata are covered; immutable canonical seeds cannot authorize project replacement.

Executed declared discovery passes 10 tests. Four independent consistency tests cover candidate/dependency binding, ownership and seed detachment, exact bootstrap manifest projection/helper closure, and five typed failure cases. Existing R1 broad matrices and installed execution evidence were inspected without claiming them as R2 reruns.

Handoff accurately describes 86 assets per root, source-only canonical seeds, unchanged installer logic and deferred dynamic settings/lifecycle integration. Adding framework.json to owned_roots describes its already-managed bootstrap behavior; no later workflow is represented as complete.

TASK-005 AC1/AC2 advance REQ-08/AC-08 within approved graph r4 and its unchanged structural task digest. Exact candidate/R1/context/policy/evidence bindings and four-path scope reproduce. Downstream ownership/dependencies remain sequenced; no new contract, dependency or structural replan is required.
